ops.title: project: cc-transcript v14.6.0 (2026-07-19, commit a83aaf4 on main) shipped the structural command-parsing primitives = Phase A of the captain-hook dual-mode-Command plan; Phase B (captain-hook consumption, pin >=14.6) still pending; multi-session release-
ops.body:
**cc-transcript v14.6.0** (commit `a83aaf4` on origin/main, tag `v14.6.0`, PyPI live, 2026-07-19) shipped the structural command-parsing primitives that captain-hook's rm-guard + dual-mode `Command` need. This is **Phase A** of the approved 2-phase plan (`plans/our-hook-tha-tblocks-twinkling-tower.md`). **Phase B (captain-hook consumption) is NOT done** — see below.

What landed in cc-transcript (all in `rust/crates/core/src/command.rs` + pyo3 bindings):
- **`Word` view** on `Command.words` (words[0]=executable, words[1:] ∥ args): `.raw` (verbatim), `.value: str|None` (fully-resolved literal; None when tainted by `$VAR`/`${...}`/`$(...)`/backtick/`$((...))`), `.span: (int,int)|None` (BYTE offsets into owning `CommandLine.raw`), `.expandable` (unquoted glob/brace/word-leading-tilde). `analyze_word` per tree-sitter node kind.
- **Shell-quote/embed**: `CommandLine.quote(text)` (shlex.quote semantics), `Occurrence.quote_for(text)->str|None` + `Occurrence.embeddable(text)->bool` (context-aware over enclosing quote layers).
- **Shell `-c`/`eval` payloads as first-class spanned parts** — mirrors the existing `$(...)` substitution enumeration; the hidden `Command.substitution: bool` generalized to `nesting: u8` / `host_delta` (relative back-offset to host) / `contexts: Vec<QuoteLayer>`. `Occurrence.{nesting, host, quote_contexts}`. `PAYLOAD_DEPTH_LIMIT=3` (fall-open beyond). Non-POSIX shells (fish/csh/tcsh) enumerate span-less. Payload option-scan honors operand-terminates-options (a `-c` after a script operand does NOT enumerate; `-o`/`-euo`/`-O` consume their option-argument).
- **`CommandLine.splice` `NotEmbeddable` guard** — refuses a corrupt splice into a quoted payload; `primary()`/`head()` filter `nesting==0`.

Review (fable finder + opus refuter, ~10,500 adversarial inputs): no critical/high; both risky invariants (enclosed-span nullify exemption, host_delta contiguity) HELD; splice path byte-correct. 2 fixes applied: operand-terminates-options false positive, and `word_expandable` tilde-must-lead. Decision/design records: the approved plan file + this session.

**Phase B (captain-hook) — STILL PENDING** (tasks #12/#13): dual-mode `Command` (plain-word pattern → structural executable match via `structural_argv` predicate + `_runs_structurally`, regex-flavored → `re.search`, regex pinned to `nesting==0`), delete `SAFE_WORD`/`SHELL_C_FLAG`/`unescape_shell`/`plain_words`/`emit_token`/`nested_command_string`/`descend_rm` (replaced by `Word.value`/`quote_for`/`embeddable` + payload occurrences), thin `normalize_executable`→`executable_name` + `resolve_cd`, nested-payload REWRITE via splice (forfeit-to-block on quote-context impossibility), walker scope-aware cwd threading, `to=`/`block_if` filter to `nesting==0`. Pin `cc-transcript[judge]>=14.6,<15`. Keep `glob.translate`.

Hard-won release lessons (this was a multi-session race):
- **cc-transcript is worked on by MANY concurrent sessions** actively committing + releasing. Version space burned `b02213b → v14.5.0 → c7813f00 → cb749e7f` DURING one session; pick the release number from PyPI/tags at tag time (14.6.0 was next-free), and rebase onto LIVE main right before pushing.
- **Isolation dance for a shared working tree** ([[commit-only-fully-owned-files]] extended): fresh git worktree off the trunk tip; copy trunk-untouched source wholesale; hunk-merge the few shared source files (here `python.rs` embedded_literals); REGENERATE the generated artifacts (`_native.pyi` via `cargo run -p cc-transcript-py --bin stub_gen`, `__init__.pyi` via `python scripts/gen_export_stub.py`, `great-docs.yml` via `cc-guides render`) from the isolated source — never carry them. Prove isolation with `git diff <base> --stat` = only your files.
- **Docs fragment traps**: `great-docs.yml` is hook-protected (can't hand-edit — must render). `cc-guides render` needs the FULL 40-char cc-skills sha (resolve via `git -C ~/Code/cc-skills rev-parse <abbrev>`) + `--lock-version` matching main (0.1.39), then restore `cc-guides.lock` to `@main`. The curated `Word` reference must go in the FRAGMENT (source), or CI re-render drops it (main's 7b0daec did exactly that). `__init__.pyi` is generator-owned (a88aa87) — regen, don't carry.
- **Cleaned my Phase A out of the shared MAIN tree** per user instruction (reverted authored source + reset derived stubs to base; codex-rollout session's WIP untouched — I couldn't coordinate with it directly).
- **Lane outages mid-session**: codex/sol DOWN until Jul 26 2026 (usage limit); fable-5 limit reached. Phase B routes to **opus**. Adversarial review prompts run fine on opus/fable (the OpenAI-cyber-filter issue is codex-only).
- Release model: tag `v*` → `.github/workflows/release-pypi.yml` (reusable build → PyPI trusted publishing → GitHub release). Guides/CI also fire on the main push. `git push origin HEAD:main` fast-forward advances the jj-colocated trunk fine (other sessions' jj fetch it).
